name: Infinity Timetable 2.5.0
notes:
What's new in 2.5.0
- New Glass 3D look in your school colours: frosted panels, raised lesson cards that lift when you point at them
- 3D week: see any class, teacher or room as a 3D board you can turn, zoom and spin (Timetable > 3D week)
- Motion switch in Settings > Appearance: smooth, or off for slow computers
- Printouts and ID cards are unchanged

Also in 2.4: the new Windows program with daily backups, phones on Wi-Fi, and the phone layout with My day and quick cover.

Updating keeps all your timetables, settings and your licence.
